name: MC3a one setting misses its stated figure: the optimal-play solve of stake tier 0 lowered to 99.7 %
guard: FIXPASS2 class C3, 14 Oct 2026: (i) a miss on the one setting the RTP table holds (stake tier 0) must end RTP FIGURE OVERSTATED, exit 5, never exit 1 or 2. The table's figure is the optimal-play solve, outputs/optimal-play-rtp.json duel.rtp; a lowered pay-table cell reaches it only through npm run compute-optimal-rtp, and every Pass 1 statistic of the pinned simulation is recomputed from the pay table (npm run simulate), neither of which is re-run in a mutation (the simulation is never re-run on this machine). So the solve's output is the cell changed: duel.rtp 0.9990000000028132 → 0.9970000000028132 (rtpPercent 99.700000, 0.2 pp under the 99.9 % claim), the artifact re-pinned in src/artifact-pins.ts, table and record regenerated. Before C3 Step 26 held duel.rtpPercent to the published 99.900000 ± 0.0001 pp and failed this (exit 1) before the rule; it now fails only a figure above it.
